reviewer: Codex manual reading of complete stored answers, products, claims and supporting quotes; not independent human assessment
summary: Nine of twelve turns were accepted and shortening/mobile checks passed. SMS and reported-interaction recall paused. Handoff and summary incorrectly presented the eventual completion boundary as current completion. The full acceptance still fails; later corrections need fresh live qualification.

findings.result: Contextual Why and evidence follow-ups no longer clarify. Rationale answers still add a spurious causal link to payer authority. Evidence answer names the source categories but mislabels the request ID as the note ID; exact passages remain in expandable citations.

Email excludes internal metadata and warmer refinement reduces its length with correct lineage. Handoff and summary include raw citation IDs and falsely report dependency completion. The SMS proposed restricted note/request details and was correctly paused.
The interaction and recall were tagged as facts and correctly paused. The summary omitted the unverified report.

findings.additionalIssues: Two rationale segments attach payer authority as a cause for follow-up; one mislabels a request ID; seven segments include a request ID absent from their own supporting quotes. These are distinct semantic/citation-coverage issues, not proof that every underlying document statement is false.
findings.limitation: The reviewer accepted these issues. Exact quotes alone do not establish entailment or current-state correctness.

findings.result: All strict viewport, composer, overflow, source expansion and feedback checks passed. Manual 375x812 screenshot confirms visible lead and composer. No workflow effects or decisions were created.

limitations: Developer-authored repeated synthetic suite; no independent holdout.
A parallel boundary submission received the explicit demo-busy retry state and captured no turns. It does not establish boundary acceptance.
